result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the delivery time text for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is broken/overlapped, displaying '25-380rddelivery' instead of properly formatted delivery time information.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays malformed text '25-380rddelivery' instead of a properly formatted delivery time. The numbers and text appear to be overlapping or incorrectly positioned.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout/wrapping to properly display the delivery time as 'XX-XX min delivery' with correct spacing and line breaks. Verify the data source is returning properly formatted content.
